coordinates: CAD world coordinates: +Z up; front is -Y. Explode offsets are illustrative, not an assembly-motion simulation.

parts.label: Base enclosure
parts.description: Fixed electronics housing with a closed USB wall and BOOT access bore. No DC-jack hole is modeled; drill it after checking the real jack and wiring.

parts.label: Main lid
parts.description: Removable lid over the electronics. This fixed part does not carry spool weight.

parts.label: Weighing carrier
parts.description: Floating carrier attached to the load cell. Keep it clear of the fixed enclosure.

parts.label: Rear cradle rail
parts.description: One of two identical printed rails supporting the upright spool rims.

parts.label: Front cradle rail
parts.description: Second instance of the same rail. Its placement is separate and selectable.

parts.label: Adjustable side guide
parts.description: Adjusts to the spool width. Target range: 50–100 mm.

parts.label: NFC side guide
parts.description: Opposite guide supports the movable reader beside the spool flange.

parts.label: NFC reader pod
parts.description: Printed reader housing. Rotate the seated spool to align its tag with the reader.

parts.label: NFC pod cover
parts.description: Removable rear cover for the PN532 board and its wiring.

parts.label: Indicator front panel
parts.description: Fixed front panel with five light openings. OLED variant also has a display window.

parts.label: Indicator rear cover
parts.description: Supports the LED strip and optional OLED with insulating foam or adhesive.

parts.label: 5 kg load cell
parts.description: Nominal 80 × 12.7 × 12.7 mm bar cell. Verify the delivered cell, threads and calibration.

parts.label: ESP32-S3 controller
parts.description: N16R8 development board reference. PCB, connectors and BOOT button are approximate; verify your board.

parts.label: HX711 amplifier
parts.description: Nominal HX711 PCB envelope. Receives the load-cell signal; actual wiring is not modeled.

parts.label: PN532 NFC reader
parts.description: PN532 module reference inside the side pod. Board and wire fit require a physical check.

parts.label: Five addressable LEDs
parts.description: 5 V strip at 60 LEDs/metre, 16.67 mm centres. Strip width and package dimensions remain provisional.

parts.label: 0.96-inch OLED
parts.description: Generic 128 × 64 OLED envelope. Controller, PCB size and pin order require identification.

parts.label: Four adjustable stops
parts.description: Reference screws for the overload stops. Other assembly fasteners are not modeled.

parts.label: Reference spool
parts.description: 200 mm diameter × 80 mm wide reference spool. Design target: up to 100 mm wide; physical fit unverified.

parts.label: Unassigned power space
parts.description: Space reference only, not a converter or a mount. Glue an insulated 12 V-to-5 V converter to a suitable fixed wall after checking fit.

parts.label: Internal USB plug space
parts.description: Provisional 10 × 22 × 12 mm angled-plug envelope. No external USB opening.

parts.label: BOOT tool approach
parts.description: Approximate access path to the onboard BOOT button; verify reach with the actual board.

parts.label: PN532 wire space
parts.description: Reserved connector clearance. No real wire routing or cable stiffness is represented.

parts.label: Load-cell wire space
parts.description: Reserved wire-exit clearance at the load cell, not a cable model.

parts.label: OLED pin space
parts.description: Provisional OLED header and connector allowance; check the supplied module.

parts.label: Four lid fastener sets
parts.description: Four nominal M3 screws, washers and nuts for the main lid. Illustrated hardware envelopes; actual screw fit remains untested.

parts.label: Four rail fastener sets
parts.description: Nominal M3 screws, washers and nuts at the two cradle rails. The exploded layout is illustrative, not an installation sequence.

parts.label: Four guide clamp sets
parts.description: Nominal M3 clamp screws, washers and nuts for width adjustment. Inspect the assembled view for their exact modeled locations.
